review_scope: Revised pre-render plan only. No render, implementation or live verification claimed.

palette.finding: Sage/viridian/apricot architecture is distinct from the previous two films' aubergine/fuchsia and parchment/oxblood/brass. Named hex roles and human-choice mood are concrete.

light.finding: Diffuse upper-left window key, bounce, rim and four depth planes establish the room. Artifact shots deliberately fix registration; signature shot 10 now has real separated desk/notice/model planes and rise/backtrack. The previous static signature contradiction is resolved.

shape_language.finding: Large rounded continuous human platform contrasts with small rectangular detachable sidecar. Round coils, ivory sheets and dotted portions preserve distinct meanings. OFF explicitly changes neither care geometry nor lighting.

casting.finding: GearLever, FullTapeMachine, Sheet and generic Character rigs are shelf-first and appropriate. Human tasks are directed. No new hero is needed; transport-state extension is a justified reuse improvement. Current beat-level storyboard controls cast placement over the older inventory ranges.

motion_language.finding: Paper displacement, review reversal, permission-first linkage, recorder braking and subordinate exit are causal. The false clinical-control reach is gone. Blur and damped settle are assigned sparingly.

composition.finding: Named safe regions, central focal actions and quiet architectural negative space make the hierarchy executable. Model-on-dated-notice is the signature; unchanged-room reveal is its human payoff. Shot-specific hero tiers and anchors now support the plan. Attribution is continuous on hypothetical care scenes.

craft_advance.finding: Explicit paused/running transport preserves legacy fill behavior and decouples recording from capacity/deletion. Phase-preserving brake-followthrough is a specific reusable semantic improvement; implementation and regression tests remain required later.
